summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO across the Lantern March, with Lantern's Reach as its hub and origin/class stories extending through streamed regions. MMORPG Tools owns character, realm and UI lifecycle; ordered player behaviors combine movement, combat, quests, trade and flight, while scene bindings and YAML registries define world content. Tideglass Coast now includes the TID-05..09 act-two chain, from tideglass lens and fleet echoes to the relay skiff returning Orin's record to the Reach.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - realm roster and entry point for Enter World and character creation.
places/character-creation-land/ - race/class/appearance selection with preview character and creation camera.
places/main/config.yaml - continent terrain, regions, roads, scatter and atmosphere; streamed cells hold landmarks and interactions.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach hub, services, residents, quests, Shield Table, Observatory and chapter sites.

places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene, x-5z0.scene, x-5z1.scene, x-6z0.scene, x0z-1.scene, x1z0.scene, x7z-1.scene, x7z-2.scene, x2z11.scene - Briarwild/Briarkin content, northern March landmarks, Emberstone Quarry/Cinderhold and Gullrest's Saltbound content.
places/main/cells/x-9z6.scene, x-10z6..8.scene, x-11z6..7.scene - Sorrowfen around Mourner Pool: stilt village, act-one marks, drowned chapel, Orla's skiff, Mirelurker pool and echo-story sites.

places/main/cells/x-10z15.scene, x-5z16..17.scene, x-6z15..16.scene, x-7z15.scene, x-8z14..15.scene, x-9z15.scene - Tideglass Coast: quay, lighthouse, Lost-Fleet shore, lens bench, memory nets/brine collector, song beacons, estuary stone and ferry landing; x-6z16 adds the ferry-reach beacon.
places/hollowcrypt/ - separate underground dungeon entered from the mausoleum in main cell x10z-5; crypt halls, archive, Warden, Vale/Elric, candles and echoes live in its cells.
roots: world.config.yaml - main-menu-land default entry; binds player/camera templates, MMORPG UI, arrival redirect, routing and realm pulse.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/mod.json - registers MMORPG lifecycle, cameras, character/interaction behaviors and UI actions.
templates/player.js#player - ordered locomotion, movement, Vanguard, Arcanist, Pathfinder, quest, vendor, flight and vitality behaviors.
templates/camera.js#camera - gameplay camera template; MMORPG has separate creation and menu camera paths.
places/main/config.yaml - owns continent terrain and regional surface/scatter configuration; cells contribute local structures and interactions.
places/hollowcrypt/config.yaml - owns dungeon gravity, dark atmosphere, lighting and place configuration; cells bind crypt geometry and encounters.
mods/gavi/mod.json - registers Gavi crew behavior and panel, the builder-facing companion tools.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, persistence, currency and UI modules reused by MMORPG behaviors, gameplay scripts and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - character load/upsert/delete and roster population shared by menu and player lifecycle.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - room registry read by routing and realm-pulse; IDs align with realm-save.js.

scripts/lib/data/quests.yml + MMORPG lib/quest-data.js - quest definitions, eligibility and progress shared by quest-player, quest-giver and quest UI; includes origin, class, EQU/DHC, SOR-01..09 and TID-01..09 campaigns.
scripts/lib/economy.js + MMORPG lib/currency.js - integer-copper transactions/ledger and denomination formatting shared by quests, vendor, flight and UI.
scripts/lib/regions.js + scripts/terrain-reach.js - regional classification and continent height/material generation used by terrain and region display, including Sorrowfen and Tideglass Coast.
scripts/lib/data/flights.yml - roost coordinates, regions, discovery radius, fare/speed limits and clearance read by flight behavior and UI; includes Tideglass Quay.
scripts/gen/shape.js and scripts/gen/* landmark builders - primitive helpers and procedural geometry reused by scene bindings, including crypt, quarry, fen and Tideglass set pieces.
notableExports: scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom; crons/realm-pulse.js - cron.
MMORPG main-menu-mgr.js - roster selection/hydration and lifecycle; character-select.js - preview lifecycle and input; player.js - character build/save/load lifecycle.
MMORPG ui.js - UI composition/actions; lib/ui-quest.js - getPortrait, renderQuestDialog, renderTurnInDialog, renderQuestTracker; lib/version.js - game version/title/tag exports.
scripts/player.js - onInput/update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - gait; scripts/vitality.js - scheduled fall/rise and health-mending update.
scripts/quest-player.js - onInput/update; scripts/elric.js and scripts/townsfolk.js - resident behavior; scripts/lib/economy.js - realmOf, ledger, feedback, move.

scripts/vanguard.js - onInput, endAction, land; scripts/arcanist.js - onInput, release, wardEnd, endAction; scripts/pathfinder.js - onInput, release, update, endAction; scripts/lib/kit.js - class/combat helpers.
scripts/crypt-gate.js - onTriggerEnter, onCross, onRefuse; scripts/candle-warden.js - onSpawn, update; scripts/gen/crypt.js - HALLS, geometry, collider.

scripts/gen/fen.js and scripts/gen/tide.js - geometry, collider for procedural Sorrowfen and Tideglass props; scripts/lib/regions.js - REGIONS, MARCH, regionAt; scripts/terrain-reach.js - regional terrain constants and height/material exports.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state, character yaw and animation channels; gait samples prior-tick movement velocity.
MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots and persisted character records, including discovered roosts and quest state.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js - class action/cooldown/combat state; scripts/lib/kit.js drill writes active quest tally and _questSave for matching props.
scripts/quest-player.js - quest/tally, inventory/xp/dialog/cache state, quest marks/flags, deferred owedItems and quest travel transitions; woodcutting owns tree fall/regrowth presentation.
scripts/lib/economy.js - coin movement, purse floor and ledger writes; scripts/vendor.js owns shop state and transaction handling.
scripts/flight.js - per-player discovered roosts, flightMap, flying/landing state and nearby-roost hint; scripts/gryphon-flight.js owns spawned mount route and rider landing.
scripts/vitality.js - player safe return position, dying timer and out-of-combat health recovery; scripts/candle-warden.js owns boss encounter state and credits boss/sweep/sigil quest tallies.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → main gameplay lifecycle.

Arrival outside main-menu-land without fresh _worldEnterAt or creation-place _creationEnterAt → scripts/arrival.js redirects to menu; menu Enter/Create and scripts/crypt-gate.js stamp transition exceptions.
main-menu-mgr loads current room SQL roster and population; api.enterPlace routes selected character to saved place/position; routing validates requested room, then last room, then main.
scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js read realms.yml; room cron writes player count to realm_pulse, which realm-save reads for roster UI.
Character creation race/class → lib/races.js race start and character state → MMORPG player.js/realm-save upsert to realm characters table keyed by user, realm and slot.
templates/player.js order → locomotion → movement → classes → quest-player → vendor → flight → vitality; moveX/moveZ/jump and camera intents are consumed by player.js/wow-move.js under place gravity.
Attack/cast inputs → class abilities and scripts/lib/missiles.js → targets/enemies; wolves.js, configurable scavengers.js and candle-warden.js consume combat state and issue damage/kill credits.

Interact/E → quest-player resolves NPCs, talkers, readable props, caches, timber and quest-mark objects; quest marks count only active incomplete objectives; townsfolk.yml state.who supplies NPC dialogue.

quests.yml → quest-data eligibility/progress/status → quest-player and quest-giver/UI; Q008 + EQU-09 gate DHC-01..04, DHC-04 enables SOR-01..04, and SOR-05..09 advances Eda's testimony through the Shield Table and witnesses.

TID-01..04 scene marks and coast NPCs → tideglass survey, registry, lighthouse, shells, drydocks/ferry rope; TID-05..09 then count tide_shard/lens_ground/fleet_charted, memory_freed/brine_collector, fleet_echo_met/oath_refused, song_beacon/estuary_stilled and skiff_boarded.
TID-09 quest mark on Rowan's relay skiff → quest-player applies ms.travel, zeroes velocity and flashes screen to move the hero to the Reach; turn-in at obs-npc-leth delivers Captain Orin's record.

Procedural scene bindings pass kind/seed/LOD/shape parameters → scripts/gen/fen.js or scripts/gen/tide.js geometry/collider; scripts/terrain-reach.js and lib/regions.js provide continent height/material and region identity.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/ landmark builders reuse scripts/gen/shape.js procedural geometry helpers, varied by landmark and parameters; crypt.js supplies Hollowcrypt halls, rooms and furniture.
scripts/gen/fen.js - procedural marsh props reused by Sorrowfen cells, varied by kind/seed/LOD; boardwalk geometry and collider share length/width/elevation parameters.

scripts/gen/tide.js - Tideglass lighthouse, quay, drydock, beacon, stake, ferry post, registry, net rack, lens bench, shard, collector, memory net, estuary pillar and relay skiff share shape helpers; kind/LOD/length/width vary each piece.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, mushroom.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter geometry reused by place bindings, varied by layer density, scale, seed or per-item params.
scripts/gen/tree.js with scripts/tree-look.js - painted bark/alpha-cut foliage recur in forest layers and placed scatters, varied by tree kind and LOD.
MMORPG player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle registered by mod.json; camera phases and lib/ui-* renderers are modular and composed by ui.js.
scripts/wolves.js and scripts/scavengers.js share roam/chase/attack/leash/death patterns; scavenger camps can override health, damage, scale, reward and tally key.
scripts/flower.js and mushroom.js with their look materials - painted wildflower frames and mushroom caps vary by frame/cap parameters in terrain scatter.
migrationNotes: Money is one integer copper amount; 100 copper = 1 silver and 100 silver = 1 gold. Route transactions through scripts/lib/economy.js to preserve purse floor, ledger and UI feedback.
templates/player.js behavior order is significant: locomotion before movement, then classes, quests, vendor, flight and vitality; gait samples prior-tick velocity.
Movement intent/locomotion scratch is room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity while place config owns gravity.
Flight roost IDs in flights.yml must correspond to flattened pads and ground y values in main config; saved state.roosts is discovery record, coordinates use place-main meters, including Tideglass.

Quest marks are scene entities tagged quest-mark with state.quest/state.mark; E counts only an active quest's incomplete objective. Crypt gate links are state.link place/entity targets and stamp _worldEnterAt before crossing.

Quest/NPC IDs and tally keys are exact joins across scenes, quests.yml and townsfolk.yml: preserve TID-05..09 objective mark keys, TID-09 ms.travel destination behavior, and match Tideglass townsperson state.who keys to dialogue rows.
